name: side-lying sit-up
description: A side-lying trunk curl that brings the upper shoulder toward the hip to work the obliques.
instructions: Lie on one side with your legs long and your lower arm resting on the floor for support.
Place your upper hand lightly behind your head without pulling on your neck.
Curl the side of your trunk, bringing your upper shoulder toward your hip.
Lower slowly, complete the reps, then switch sides.
